en: Oh, hi, {player}! Thanks for coming. Remember the Eevee I told you about? It's right here.
It's a rare one, and it can evolve in all sorts of ways. Would you like to raise it?
Eevee's a funny one. Its genes are unstable, so it can turn into lots of different Pokémon. Take good care of it!
No? That's a shame. If you change your mind, come back. Eevee will be here.
Whoa, your team's full! Make some room, then come and see me.
How's Eevee doing? I can't wait to see what it turns into.
My son Bill made the PC storage system you use. He's off in Ecruteak City just now.
He calls whenever he wants feeding. Typical!
Bill came home all of a sudden. He always rushes in like that, then off again!
